scope: The stock DELAY reads the first 16 bytes of the overflow run past its 508-entry table at a slow tempo with a long TIME. Overflow placement now starts at 0x400d24e0, the finished image must hold zeros at 0x400d24d0..0x400d24df whether or not DELAY is listed, and the ledger refuses a fixed cave there beside a listed DELAY. Two fresh native builds of 256 selections (the FM Synth and Euclid coverage sets of module:verify), one with the base tree and one with this builder, in the pinned toolchain image with the static stock loader; the base tree carries FM Synth 0.1.3, whose page no longer sits in the run. 254 results are identical, 130 of them refusals with identical text. 34 selections the declaration ledger refuses before any placement (colliding modules, identical text before and after) are left out of this record; the other 222 are listed. Two images change, one selection under both chooser settings: its label formatters overflow into the run, and they now start 16 bytes later (every reference moves by 0x10; 0x400d24d0..0x400d24df were code and are zeros). No refused selection now builds and no built selection is refused. The browser composer matches native on all 256 rows before and after (126 images outside the platform writes, 130 matching refusals). No hardware result is inferred; the DELAY difference itself was measured under the ColdFire port, not heard on a unit.
